title: Enforcement by state and county authorities.
bodyText: All state and county health authorities and police officers shall enforce this chapter and the rules, orders, and permits of the department.
bodyHtml: [§342B-51]  Enforcement by state and county authorities.  All state and county health authorities and police officers shall enforce this chapter and the rules, orders, and permits of the department. [L 1992, c 240, pt of §1]
